About bla5k

bla5k is a hand-organized directory of the internet’s best tools, websites, and communities. The web is enormous and noisy — great resources are easy to miss. bla5k exists to cut through that noise with a clean, categorized reference you can actually navigate.

What you’ll find

  • Carefully sorted categories, from AI tools to design, learning, and communities.
  • A short, honest write-up for every entry — what it is and why it’s worth your time.
  • An instant search so you can jump straight to what you need.

How entries are chosen

Every listing earns its place on usefulness alone. We add resources we’d genuinely recommend to a friend. The directory grows continually as we discover more of the web’s hidden gems.

Get in touch

Have a tool we should include, or spotted something out of date? We’d love to hear from you — head to the Contact page.
